caption:
ChatGPT can sound sure and be wrong. Made-up sources, names and numbers are the common failure.

Catch it in three steps: ask for source links, open the link and check it says that, then compare with a second tool.

Safer prompt: If you are not sure, say so. Give a source for every number.

Never submit or post an AI answer you have not verified.

Save this and send it to the friend who copy-pastes.
